posts.text: While I agree with your analysis when you look at it from the business point of view, however, in my opinion, this is a good company from investment point of view - Current valuation is fair Management seems honest and knowing the business better - maintaining a good ROCE For the size of this company, oversupply is not a problem. posts.text: Just one another thing in this stock. There are around 150+ unlisted player in this segment . This segment will move into oversupply which will squeeze margins. Another thing, promoters are good but they never guide for reducing the employee cost etc. Lastly not only the unlisted player will create oversupply but as per the concall ; players who are into 440kv segments are also expanding in this segment. There is no barriers to entry. Only thing I find good is that Rajasthan is the major area for non fossil fuel expansion so they might get demand as they are based out of jaipur. Rest i do not…
